name: ID Card Renewal Notice
summary: Invites you to renew an expiring ID card and explains the appointment, biometric, payment, and document steps.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Book the appointment as soon as possible if no slot has been assigned yet.
guidance.deadlineSummary: Book or attend by the date shown on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: your ID card is expiring or the Interior Ministry is prompting you to renew it
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use the booking route or bureau details printed on the notice before arriving in person.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you cannot get an appointment, your personal details are wrong, or you need to update status information
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the renewal date, bureau, required documents, fee details, and whether a biometric visit is required.

sections.explainer: Renewal timing — tells you when your current ID expires or when the authority expects you to renew it. Do not leave it to the last week if you need the document for travel or banking.
sections.deadline: Renew before the date shown on the notice

sections.explainer: Personal details — check your Hebrew and English names, ID number, and current address. Errors here can carry forward into the renewed document.
sections.actionRequired: Flag any spelling or address error before the appointment so you know what supporting proof to bring.

sections.explainer: Documents to bring — usually the current ID card, passport, proof of address if something changed, and any name-change or status documents that apply to you.
sections.actionRequired: Prepare the originals, not only copies, unless the notice explicitly says uploaded scans are enough.

sections.explainer: Fee or payment reference — explains whether a renewal fee is due and how to pay it before or during the appointment.
sections.actionRequired: Pay in advance if the notice allows it and keep the receipt with your documents.

sections.explainer: Appointment and branch details — tells you which bureau to attend and whether you need to book a slot. Biometric renewals usually require an in-person visit.
sections.actionRequired: Book the appointment as soon as possible if no slot has been assigned yet.
sections.deadline: Book or attend by the date shown on the notice
